result:
I moved the "Team Created" success notification out of the component and into the mutation hook, so components no longer call `useNotifications`.

- **`apps/react-vite/src/features/teams/api/create-team.ts`**: `useCreateTeam` now calls `useNotifications()` and fires `addNotification({ type: 'success', title: 'Team Created' })` in `onSuccess`, after the teams query invalidation and before the caller's `onSuccess`.
- **`apps/react-vite/src/features/teams/components/create-team.tsx`**: removed the `useNotifications` import and call, and the `mutationConfig` block. It now calls `useCreateTeam()` with no arguments.

I did not run tests, lint or the app, as you asked.

The existing `discussions` and `comments` feature components (for example `features/discussions/components/create-discussion.tsx`) still call `useNotifications` directly, so they break the same rule. I left them alone because they are outside this change. Say if you want them moved too.
